root_cause.primary: The two unsigned fresh15 observer processes were supervised side processes, but the v51 restart runbook and live-launch path did not require their startup or freshness before arming the backend.

open_position_safety_during_incident.limitation: The unavailable observer could not supply a prospective opposite entry signal during the outage.

missed_opportunity_reconstruction.method: Reconstruct each missing completed 15m close from retained source-native one-minute evidence and compare it with the frozen prior breakout bounds. The price-breakout condition is necessary regardless of unavailable L2 pressure.
missed_opportunity_reconstruction.conclusion: No eligible v3 onset or opposite entry intent was missed because every missing close remained inside its frozen breakout interval.
missed_opportunity_reconstruction.falsifier: Any exact source-native completed close outside the serialized prior breakout interval invalidates the no-missed-onset conclusion and requires a full L2 reconstruction.

technical_change.description: Require fresh exact SP500 and SPCX observer identities before the v51 live launcher may construct a backend command, and document both observer startup commands before preflight.
technical_change.remaining_limitation: The guard prevents a launch with stale observers but does not automatically restart an observer that exits after backend startup.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: Missing fresh15 observer processes caused the index provider telemetry outage.
hypothesis_ledger.evidence: Both processes were absent while route evaluations reported observer_status_stale; restoring the exact processes advanced preserved cursors and restored complete route anatomy.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: The outage caused an eligible SP500 or SPCX entry or opposite intent to be missed.
hypothesis_ledger.evidence: All ten missing completed closes per symbol remained inside the necessary frozen breakout bounds.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: Persistent automatic observer supervision should be added.
hypothesis_ledger.evidence: Startup validation closes the launch omission but cannot recover a post-start observer exit.
hypothesis_ledger.minimum_validation: A reviewed singleton supervisor must preserve exact cursors, reject duplicate owners, expose freshness to the checkpoint, restart only the unsigned report-only observer, and prove no retroactive decisions across crash recovery.

change_proposal.recommendation: Retain the startup freshness guard and evaluate a separate singleton report-only observer supervisor before any future v51 restart.
change_proposal.why_now: The current run spent roughly 2.5 hours without prospective SP500/SPCX pressure decisions even though the backend itself remained healthy.
change_proposal.evidence_reviewed: Current v51 checkpoint, cohort intent-routing rows, exact observer status/cursor files, prospective decision journals, open-position protection, and reconstructed missing 15m closes.
change_proposal.observed_problem_or_opportunity: A required report-only data dependency could stop independently and make both live index routes technically unavailable.
alternatives_considered: embed unsigned market-data collection inside the order backend
change_proposal.proposed_live_change: No strategy, asset, route, signal, exit, sizing, leverage, risk, or order behavior change. The applied technical guard only refuses a future backend launch when required observers are stale. Automatic post-start supervision remains unapproved.
change_proposal.expected_upside: Prevent another live launch with unavailable index inputs and reduce unobserved route downtime if a later supervisor is approved.
change_proposal.main_risks_and_failure_modes: A supervisor could create duplicate writers, reset a cursor, emit retroactive decisions, or hide a persistent data-source failure unless it is singleton, identity-bound, and fail-closed.
change_proposal.validation_completed: Observer restart preserved both cursors, emitted no retroactive decisions, restored complete 19:30 UTC pressure history, and generated no orders. Startup-guard and runbook regressions pass.
change_proposal.validation_still_required: Prospective crash/restart soak test for any supervisor, duplicate-owner rejection, stale-status alerting, and exact checkpoint visibility.
change_proposal.success_metrics: Zero observer_status_stale evaluations after warmup during an uninterrupted run; one exact decision per completed 15m boundary; no cursor regression, duplicate decision, signer construction, or order surface.
change_proposal.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any duplicate owner, cursor regression, retroactive decision, identity mismatch, unexpected execution authority, or backend interference requires immediate supervisor shutdown while the provider remains fail-closed.
change_proposal.confidence_level: high for the diagnosed startup omission; medium for the value of future automatic supervision until crash-recovery tests pass

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Continue exact source-native SP500 and SPCX v3 prospective lifecycle collection, requiring at least one attributable eligible signal and one fully resolved lifecycle per configured side before updating the economic diagnosis.
